craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 54. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Nine-souled, standing inside the phaṭ cavity, again endowed with five phaṭs: of so-and-so thus, sins, I burn according to eight phaṭs.
l4.sanskrit_cite: navātmā phaṭpuṭāntaḥsthaḥ punaḥ pañcaphaḍanvitaḥ amukasyeti pāpāni dahāmyanu phaḍaṣṭakam
